subject: [build-blocked] frankensimCmaes.ts URL('../../') breaks the next build
body_md:
While shipping the W2 audit fixes (M-01 /receipts overflow at 320/360px on the stable alias), I hit a `Module not found: Can't resolve '../../'` at app/lib/frankensimCmaes.ts:191 (`new URL('../../', import.meta.url).href` in a Bun test-realm branch).

The runtime path is fine in the browser (the asset URL resolves at fetch time), but `next build` can't statically resolve it. `bun run build` exits 1; my force-deploys fail.

Fix is one of:
- gate the test-realm branch with a `process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` guard, or
- use a real relative path that also satisfies the static analyzer, or
- move the URL resolution to a dynamic import.

Whichever, please land soon so I can deploy the M-01 fix. The audit doc is in `docs/audit-2026-08-31-six-lens.md`. — SapphireElm
